pages.title: Cobalt
pages.text:
A deep blue Nether metal for fast mining.

- **Tier:** Diamond
- **Durability:** 1100
- **Sword damage:** 6.5
- **Armor (full set):** 15

pages.title: Getting It
pages.text: **Cobalt Ore** is found throughout the Nether, from Y 0 to Y 128, in netherrack. Mine it with an iron pickaxe or better, then smelt or blast the raw cobalt.

pages.title: The Gear
pages.text:
- **Swift:** cobalt tools are the fastest in the mod, faster than gold.
- **Quick Guard:** the cobalt shield blocks the moment you raise it, with no delay.

pages.title: Overdrive
pages.text: **Full set bonus.** Every 6 blocks you mine in a row (with at most 2 seconds between them) adds a level of Haste, up to Haste II. Stop mining and it fades.
A blast furnace works too, and is faster.
